prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1088; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you are comfortable with us recording this call?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was driving on a major road in Sugar Land, Texas, heading toward a shopping center. I was in the left turn lane at a signalized intersection.

Q: What was the traffic signal showing when you entered the intersection?

A: My light was green for the left turn, or at least it looked that way to me. I waited for oncoming traffic to clear, then started my turn.

Q: What happened next?

A: A vehicle coming from the opposite direction hit the front passenger side of my car. I didn't see it coming until right before impact.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle's headlights or signal before you started to turn?

A: I saw headlights a ways off, but I thought it was far enough away to make the turn. I may have misjudged the speed.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My neck and lower back hurt right after it happened. I've been having stiffness and some pain when I turn my head or sit for a long time.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received treatment since the accident?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same day and I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week since then.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide any records you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
